Subject: Recap: Redwood demo — decision path & requested org contacts

Alex / Tara — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can align next steps:

What we covered
- Demo: low-latency inference patterns, Dedicated vs Private deployment tradeoffs, cost levers (batching/quantization).
- Typical onboarding: security review (SOC 2 evidence), procurement lead time, and pilot sizing.

Open asks / next steps from your side
1) Economic buyer: name/title we should loop into the commercial conversations (pricing + budget).
2) Procurement timeline / any mandatory vendor intake forms (feel free to attach).
3) Security/compliance contact for SOC 2 + data handling questions.

Our proposed next steps
- If you can share the procurement timeline + contact list by EOD Thu (8/5), we’ll draft a 30/60-day mutual action plan and a ballpark commercial worksheet.
- Proposed follow-up: 30 minutes on Tue 8/10 to review MAP and sample SOW.

Attachments: redwood_demo_slides.pdf (slides), meeting recording link included below.

Thanks — I’ll loop Marissa and Ben on security and customer success details.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks, Karthik — good session. Quick responses inline:

> 1) Economic buyer: name/title we should loop into the commercial conversations (pricing + budget).
We’ll bring Sophie Lane (Sophie Lane <sophie.lane@fastlogistics.com>), VP of Operations — she owns infrastructure spend.

> 2) Procurement timeline / any mandatory vendor intake forms (feel free to attach).
I’ve uploaded our vendor onboarding timeline (FastLogistics_Vendor_Onboarding_Timeline.xlsx) to the shared drive and cc’d procurement. Typical timeline: 4–6 weeks for standard SaaS vendors, 6–10 weeks if we need legal redlines or customized data addendums.

> 3) Security/compliance contact for SOC 2 + data handling questions.
Tara is on this thread for legal; I’ll add our security lead in a follow-up (we’re short-staffed this week).

Two asks from our side:
- Can you provide a short mutual action plan (30/60-day) and a ballpark commercial range we can show Sophie?
- Also, procurement has a short vendor intake PDF — attaching procurement_form.pdf.

Thanks — will wait for the MAP draft.

Subject: Next steps & 30/60-day Mutual Action Plan (draft) — FL-092

Thanks Alex (and team) — appreciate the fast clarity. Attached is a short draft mutual action plan and a MAP checklist. High level:

Week 1 (8/6–8/12)
- Redwood: send MAP + ballpark commercial worksheet; provide SOC 2 report + sample data handling language (deliverable: security packet).
- Fast Logistics: confirm Sophie availability for pricing review; procurement to complete intake form.

Week 2–4 (8/13–9/3)
- Technical POC planning: pilot scope and success criteria (Marissa to lead).
- Security review (Liam) — complete questionnaire and network diagram.

Week 5–8 (9/4–9/30)
- Contracting: commercial terms, legal redlines.
- Pilot execution and success sign-off.

Can everyone confirm the owner for each bullet? I’ve also included a HubSpot link to the deal and a DocuSign link for a short NDA we can execute to share more detailed docs: https://hubspot.com/deal/FL-2027-092 | https://www.docusign.com/FL-092-NDA

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_FL-092.docx

If that timeline looks reasonable, I’ll slot a 30-minute meeting for Tue 8/10 11:00 AM ET to review MAP + provide the pricing worksheet.

Best regards,
